name: kind
meaning: MenuItemFlags bits 0-1: 0 = page/submenu that CROSS enters, 1 = leaf item

name: hasHandler
meaning: bit 2 (0x04): +4 is a MenuHandler, else a char* label

name: selected
meaning: bit 4 (0x10): the highlighted row; a MenuHandler reads it as the blink argument of Text_PrintfStyled (unsigned 1-bit read shr 4 / and 1 at 0x43b35c, 0x43b3a6, 0x436934)

name: childCount
meaning: number of child nodes; incremented by Menu_AddItems/Menu_AddPage on the parent; Menu_Update's draw loop runs until it has visited this many children

name: parent
meaning: index of the parent node in the same array, -1 for the root (node 0)

name: handler
meaning: union: MenuHandler void(u8 msg, MenuPage *self) when flags bit 2 is set, otherwise the char* label printed with "%s"
